headline: Basin rig count up two as prices decrease
summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up two this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 260 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 259 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is up one from last week at 588 rigs. A year ago, 540 rigs were active.
